title: Healing Tint Energy - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Healing Tint Energy in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Healing Tint Energy is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Healing Tints also grant AP.

sections.title: How to Get Healing Tint Energy
Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
